title: Chalkboard Outside The Café
tests: Tests exact words integrated into a plausible physical sign rather than a flat photo overlay.

judge.summary: A small, convincingly grounded chalkboard clearly reads “COFFEE TO GO,” while the café and wide composition remain intact.

must_haves.item: A small freestanding chalkboard is visibly standing on the pavement outside the supplied café.
must_haves.why: A wooden A-frame chalkboard stands on the pavement beside the entrance.

must_haves.item: The chalkboard reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', with all words legible.
must_haves.why: The chalk lettering clearly reads “COFFEE” above “TO GO.”

must_haves.item: The words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective, not floating over the photograph.
must_haves.why: The lettering sits within the dark board and follows its slight perspective.

must_haves.item: The sign has plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, and shadow.
must_haves.why: Its feet meet the pavement, its size fits the nearby furniture, and its lighting and cast shadow integrate plausibly with the scene.

must_haves.item: The original storefront, striped awning, outdoor tables, and wide composition remain intact.
must_haves.why: The storefront, awning, tables, and framing are preserved, with only natural occlusion from the added sign.
